Many Christians try to love their neighb: Many Christians try to love their neighbor. That means helping people, telling the truth, and sharing.
Muslims worship one God. Allah is the Ar: Muslims worship one God. Allah is the Arabic word for God. Many Muslims pray five times a day. To pray, they face Mecca. Mecca is a city. The Kaaba, a cube-shaped building, stands there. Muslims honor the prophet Muhammad.
Shabbat is a weekly rest. It begins on F: Shabbat is a weekly rest. It begins on Friday evening and ends on Saturday evening. Many Jews light candles, share a meal, and stop everyday work. Some families eat a special bread. Hanukkah is a festival of lights in late fall or winter. It lasts eight nights. Many families light a hanukkiah, a special lamp. People tell a story of a small amount of oil that burned for eight days. Some children play a small spinning game.
Diwali is a festival of lights in autumn: Diwali is a festival of lights in fall. Many Hindus mark it. Many Sikhs and many Jains mark it too. It is not only one religion’s day. Many families light lamps and share candy. People tell stories. One story many Hindus tell is about Rama and Sita coming home. Some families tell other stories.
Many Hindus try to practise ahimsa, whic: Many Hindus try to practice ahimsa, which means not harming. Hosts welcome guests. Helping others is a kind act.
Many people follow the Buddha’s teaching: Many people follow the Buddha’s teaching and practice care.
Many Buddhists follow the teaching of th: Many Buddhists follow the teaching of the Buddha. The Buddha was a teacher. Many Buddhists do not pray to a creator. Some traditions also honor other awakened teachers. Practices differ.
Many Buddhists meditate or worship in a: Many Buddhists meditate or worship in a temple. Some say vihara. Some visit a stupa. Some practice at home. Shoes often come off. The room stays quiet.
Sikhs worship one God. A short teaching,: Sikhs worship one God. A short teaching, Ik Onkar, means there is one God. Sikhs honor ten human Gurus. Guru Nanak was the first.
